GPT-6 Luna compares each citation or reference with this paper using titles, abstracts, and your criteria, evaluating up to 5 articles in parallel. Without an abstract, it uses the title only; a missing abstract alone is not a reason to disqualify. Each article gets a Keep or Disqualify decision with a reason. Disqualifications are applied only when you choose Apply. Estimated token costs are included under Literature triage in AI usage; re-evaluating incurs new cost.
